exact_result: Draft proof of local decreasing strict semipositive real-PL sequences for arbitrary classical psh functions on smooth boundaryless second-countable strict analytic curves over complete nontrivially valued fields, and consequently for every arbitrary classical psh function defined on a full projective bundle over an ordinary open subset of a smooth algebraic curve over a field with a countable dense subset. Includes minus-infinity values, finite separable mesh realization, strict descent, one fixed neighbourhood, termwise chart overlaps, and pullback through every analytic scalar extension. This is a saturated-domain higher-dimensional sector, not the full arbitrary-germ characterization.
concrete_gaps: No sharp characterization or necessity/failure range for arbitrary classical psh germs in dimension at least two.
The fibre argument needs the whole compact projective fibre; arbitrary functions on nonsaturated affine/open fibre charts are not covered.
Smooth normal unibranch examples do not establish sufficiency of normality or unibranchness alone.
No general strict PL descent through nonflat singular-curve or higher-dimensional normalization is proved.
No unrestricted non-second-countable extraction for arbitrary new starting functions, or genuine analytic counterexample to sequential regularization, is provided.
Boundary geometry and general tropical-chart overlap gluing outside the proved sector remain unresolved.
